roles.fit: Each fold's train-role genuine group-OOF rows from seed_42_fold_{fold}/oof_predictions.npz
roles.selection: Each fold's independent selection groups; labels decoded by sample_hash from provenance only for offline metrics

positive_gain_method: probability_only_gain_positive_no_call: acquire only when predicted_delta > 0, without a fixed budget cap; report its realized budget
budget_definition: expected evidence calls per row; K=round((budget-1)*N_selection) second calls for budgeted policies, deterministic tie breaks by sample_hash

expanded_state.reason: Existing protocol documents temporal_packet_cap=64 but does not establish that every stored raw temporal/IAT/prefix feature is available at the pre-acquisition observation point; Stats is explicitly completed-segment and not prefix-restricted.

target: Delta = 1[h_temporal != y] - 1[h_equal_average != y], values {-1,0,+1}; labels and p_stats are offline target construction only

comparison_rules.probability_only_gain: highest fitted predicted_delta first, exact K
comparison_rules.positive_gain_no_call: all rows with fitted predicted_delta > 0; no budget cap
comparison_rules.all_average: always acquire stats and apply fixed average

interpretation_limits: Five folds share source groups and are not independent tests
Report positive and negative fold/group results
Do not promote a method from selection outcomes to final generalization
